question: Which God is worshipped during the festival of Chhath Puja?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chhath Puja** is a Hindu festival dedicated to the worship of **Surya, the Sun God****.**
 
• The festival is celebrated for four days and is observed mainly in the regions of Bihar, Jharkhand, and Uttar Pradesh in India.
 
• During Chhath Puja, devotees worship Surya and his wife Usha, and offer prayers and offerings to seek blessings for good health, wealth, and prosperity.
 
• Agni, Indra, and Vishnu are not worshipped during the festival of Chhath Puja. However, they are important deities in Hindu mythology and are worshipped in various other festivals and rituals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] 

**Important Points__**

__
 
• ​__**Chhath puja** is dedicated to the sun god Surya. The sun is visible to every being and is the basis of life of all creatures on earth. Along with the Sun God, Chhathi Maiya is also worshipped on this day. 
 
• According to Vedic astrology, Chhathi Maiya protects children from diseases and problems and gives them long lives and good health.
